afarax is looking for a freelance Senior Functional Designer. We need you!
The project

Our client in the insurance sector, is seeking an experienced Functional Designer.

 

Objective of the job:

• Ensure the stability and operability of the (sub)application

• Be in charge of translating business requirements into a structured IT solution while keeping a functional approach

• Help translating this functional design into well-tailored technical design

• Prepare functional integration test cases based on the requirements

• Test the product before delivery to the users

• Analyse potential corrective actions to be taken

• Coordinate technical designers and programmers during implementation of functionalities

• Work closely with the business to ensure the final solution fits their needs

• Actively support the Project leaders in the project implementation

How afarax supports you?

• You benefit from our extensive network

• You will have access to projects that fit your expertise

• We help and support you throughout your project

• We offer the possibility to build a valuable and lasting partnership

• Fluent in French and/or Dutch and good knowledge of English

• Master or Engineer in IT or in a scientific domain with IT interest. Bachelor with a minimum of 5 years' experience in technical analysis

• Experience with Application Development of Administrative Senior systems in an IT department

• Mastering of MS-Office tools Senior

• Strong understanding of Source code Cobol MicroFocus and SQL server

• Web based Client/Server systems with MF back-end (Cobol MicroFocus / SQL server)

• Batch process experience

• Cobol MicroFocus / SQL server programming experience

• .NET ; SQL

• Functional analysis

• Lead Functional Analyst

• IT solution design on large scale projects

• Agile & Waterfall project methodology

• Architectural design

• Experience in the Insurance or Banking domain

• Life Insurance

• Contract management, claims and Finance

• Pragmatic & solution oriented

• Methodical, analytical and pro-active

• Quality oriented

• Good communication skills

• Quick learner

• Pro-active and flexible

• Client Oriented

• Able to deal with punctual stress situations

• Able to plan own work with respect of deadlines and budget

afarax is looking for a freelance Senior Functional / Business Analyst. We need you!
The project

Our client in the Insurance sector, is seeking an experienced Functional / Business Analyst.
Main responsibilities

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand, clarify and challenge their needs

• Translate business needs into complete, precise and structured functional requirements for IT implementation teams

• Analyse business processes, user needs, application behaviour and system dependencies

• Produce functional analyses, requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria

• Understand the existing application landscape and how front-end and back-end components interact

• Identify interfaces, dependencies, data flows and potential impacts across connected applications

• Ensure that functional requirements are aligned with the existing solution architecture

• Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, analysts and development teams

• Prepare test scenarios and test cases to validate delivered solutions

• Support test execution, defect clarification and functional validation when required

• Ensure traceability between business requirements, functional specifications and delivered functionality

• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous team improvement

• Communicate progress, decisions, risks and functional issues clearly to all relevant stakeholders

How afarax supports you?

• You benefit from our extensive network

• You will have access to projects that fit your expertise

• We help and support you throughout your project

• We offer the possibility to build a valuable and lasting partnership

Required experience and expertise:

• At least seven years of experience as a Functional Analyst, Business Analyst or IT Business Analyst

• Strong experience in insurance business analysis

• Good understanding of insurance products, processes and operational environments

• Proven experience translating business needs into detailed functional requirements

• Strong stakeholder-management and negotiation capabilities

• Experience working with complex application landscapes

• Good understanding of front-end and back-end architecture, system integration and application dependencies

• Ability to understand how application components, interfaces and data flows are interconnected

• Experience preparing and supporting functional testing, User Acceptance Testing and solution validation

• Strong analytical and structured mindset, with particular attention to accuracy and completeness

• Experience working in large, multidisciplinary Agile teams

• Ability to collaborate with Business Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Functional Analysts, Solution Architects and front-end and back-end developers

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Team-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable working with diverse stakeholders

• Leadership mindset and ability to facilitate alignment without direct authority

 

Languages

• English: Fluent or strong professional proficiency; primary language for communication with development teams

• French: Fluent or strong professional proficiency; required for communication with business stakeholders, Product Owners and internal colleagues

• Dutch: Passive understanding is mandatory

Are you looking for a varied and challenging job in the logistics sector? GXO Logistics in Mechelen is looking for motivated Allround Warehouse Operators to strengthen our team!

Your responsibilities

As an allround warehouse operator, you will be involved in various steps of the logistics process. Your tasks may include:

 

 
• Checking, packing, labeling, and preparing products for shipment 
 
• Repairing or adjusting damaged or incorrect goods (rework) 
 
• Performing customization tasks based on specific client requirements 
 
• Scanning and registering goods in the WMS system 
 
• Handling administrative tasks in Excel and Word 
 
• Moving goods using EPT, stacker, or forklift 
 
• Reporting discrepancies and results to the team leader 
 
• Assisting with inventory counts and stock control 
 
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment 

What are we looking for?

 

 
• You understand and speak English very well 
 
• You are available to work the night shift OR a 2-shift system 
 
• You have experience operating an EPT / BTY and forklift 
 
• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word 
 
• You work accurately, are well-organized, and have an eye for detail 
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently 
 
• You have at least 1 year of experience in a logistics or production environment 
 
• You are physically capable of lifting heavier objects

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;
  • You make sure that stability work is not overlooked;
  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:

  • A telehandler certificate is a plus!
  • You have extensive experience as a renovation worker;
  • You have a category B driving license and can easily commute to the company;
  • You speak Dutch or English

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

Preventive Maintenance & Inspections: Perform maintenance work according to an established schedule. Following up on inspections, checklists and preparing work orders.

-Have completed a technical education, preferably in an electromechanical field (min A2)

-Experience with maintenance and breakdowns in technical installations.

-You are practical and can work independently. -Eye for detail and work accurately. -Languages: Dutch & English

-Flexible and willing to work in both Zele and Ghent.

-Communicative skills and can work well with external parties and colleagues.

-Hands-on mentality and is proactive in solving problems.

jobs.occupation: Country Head of IT - Global Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a leading global industrial and manufacturing organization with operations across multiple continents and a strong presence in Thailand. The business operates in a highly technology-driven environment, with significant manufacturing operations and a broad international network.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the overall IT strategy and operations across Thailand.
• Act as the senior technology partner to country and business leadership.
• Ensure reliable, secure, and effective IT services across the organization.
• Oversee infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data, end-user services, and technology operations.
• Drive technology transformation and modernization initiatives aligned with business priorities.
• Establish strong IT governance, standards, policies, and risk management.
• Lead and develop the local IT organization and technology capabilities..
• Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers.
• Oversee IT budgets, investments, and resource planning.
• Work closely with regional and global technology teams on enterprise initiatives.
• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, efficiency, and scalability.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• 10+ years of experience in IT, with significant leadership responsibility
• Experience leading IT within a large, multinational organization
• Strong background across IT operations, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and technology transformation
• Experience managing teams, budgets, vendors, and complex technology environments
• Strong business partnering and stakeholder management capabilities
• Ability to operate effectively across both local and regional/global environments
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Preferred

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
• Previous country, regional, or enterprise IT leadership experience
• Experience leading technology transformation in a complex multinational organization
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity, governance, and IT risk
• Excellent English communication skills
